citations.assessment: Shmuel cites Zevulun ben Dan as a case in which a grandfather taught his grandson. He does not state that he himself taught him.
Rashi gives the broad description scholar in their time.

notes.text: Shmuel cites Zevulun ben Dan as a case in which a grandfather taught his grandson. He does not state that he himself taught him.
Rashi gives the broad description scholar in their time.
Shmuel’s own studenthood is an inference in Heilprin’s heading. Shmuel cites the example and the Bavli names the grandfather as teacher. Rashi says a student who lived in their days.
